articles.title: Thousands Still Missing After Deadly Floods Destroy Villages on Nepal-China Border
articles.summary: Severe flooding hit a mountainous area along the border between Nepal and China four days ago, wiping out entire villages. Thousands of people are still unaccounted for, and families are desperately waiting for news of their loved ones. Rescue teams have been searching through mud and debris, but the remote and rugged landscape has made the work very difficult. Authorities in Nepal have also warned that more flooding could happen soon because river water levels remain dangerously high. The disaster has shown how vulnerable mountain communities can be to extreme weather events, which scientists say are becoming more frequent due to climate change.

lv1: Where did the terrible flooding happen? (這場嚴重水災發生在哪裡？)
Why is it hard for rescue teams to find missing people? (為什麼救援人員很難找到失蹤的人？)
lv2: Why do you think mountain villages are especially at risk during heavy floods? (你認為為什麼山區村莊在大水災時特別危險？)
What can governments do to warn people before a flood strikes a remote area? (政府可以怎樣在水災來臨前向偏遠地區居民發出警告？)
lv3: Some people argue that wealthy countries, which produce the most pollution, should pay to help poorer countries recover from climate-related disasters. Do you agree or disagree, and why? (有人認為製造最多污染的富裕國家應該出資幫助較貧窮國家從氣候災難中復原，你同意嗎？為什麼？)

When a disaster strikes a remote border region between two countries, how should the two governments cooperate in rescue efforts, and what challenges might arise? (當災難發生在兩國邊境的偏遠地區時，兩國政府應如何合作救援？可能面臨什麼困難？)

articles.source: Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism
articles.adaptedFrom: Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism — Digital News Report 2026
articles.title: New Global Report: More People Are Using AI Chatbots to Get Their Daily News
articles.summary: A major new international study has found that a growing number of people around the world now turn to artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots when looking for news and information, instead of reading traditional newspapers or visiting news websites. The Reuters Institute's Digital News Report 2026 also found that video creators on platforms like YouTube are becoming increasingly trusted sources of news, especially among younger generations. Researchers are asking important questions about whether AI tools always give accurate and balanced information. Experts worry that if people rely too heavily on AI for news, they may end up with a one-sided or incomplete picture of what is happening in the world.

lv1: What is one new way people are getting their news according to this report? (根據這份報告，人們獲取新聞的一種新方法是什麼？)
Which age group is most likely to watch video creators for news? (哪個年齡層最常透過影片創作者獲取新聞？)
lv2: Why might it be a problem if people only use AI chatbots to learn about what is happening in the world? (如果人們只用AI聊天機械人了解世界大事，可能會有什麼問題？)
How is getting news from a YouTube creator different from reading a report by a trained journalist? (從YouTube創作者獲取新聞與閱讀受過訓練的記者所寫的報道有什麼分別？)
lv3: Should AI companies be required by law to label news summaries produced by AI so readers know the information did not come from a human journalist? Why or why not? (人工智能公司是否應該依法為AI撰寫的新聞摘要加上標籤，讓讀者知道內容並非由記者撰寫？為什麼？)
As AI becomes a major news source for many people, what responsibilities do schools have to teach students how to judge whether information is reliable? (當AI成為許多人的主要新聞來源，學校有什麼責任教導學生判斷資訊是否可靠？)

articles.title: 新學年下周二開始　教育局長提醒學生盡早調整作息時間
articles.summary: 香港新學年將於下周二（9月1日）正式展開。教育局局長表示，學生和家長應把握最後幾天假期，逐步調整日常作息規律，讓身體提前適應早起上學的節奏，以積極正向的心態迎接新學期。此外，政府亦宣布將推出洪水橋大學城用地，供大專院校申請，有關地點佔地約22公頃，是北都大學城計劃的一部分，旨在配合香港未來的高等教育發展需要。

lv1: 香港新學年將於哪一天正式開始？
教育局局長建議學生在開學前應該怎樣做？
lv2: 為什麼在開學前調整睡眠時間對學生的學習表現有幫助？
洪水橋大學城計劃對香港高等教育發展有什麼意義？
lv3: 有人認為香港的學生學業壓力過大，新學年開始時心情難以「積極正向」。你認為學校和家長可以怎樣共同改善學生的心理健康？
政府在北都興建大學城，吸引更多大學進駐。你認為這對本地學生有什麼好處和潛在問題？

articles.title: 尼泊爾北部邊境爆發嚴重泥石流　洪流湧入中國西藏邊境地區
articles.summary: 尼泊爾北部邊境地區日前發生嚴重泥石流災難，大量泥沙和洪水沿峽谷急速湧向中國西藏日喀則市一帶的邊境縣份，造成重大傷亡及失蹤。消息指習近平已就事件下達搜救指示。入境事務處表示暫未接獲港人求助，但會密切留意事態發展。今次災難再次引起外界關注山區極端天氣所帶來的破壞力，以及相關地區居民的人身安全問題。

lv1: 今次泥石流災難發生在哪個地區？
香港入境事務處對今次事件有何回應？
lv2: 為什麼山區地帶特別容易受到泥石流的威脅？
當天災發生在兩個國家的邊境地區時，兩國政府在救援工作上可能面對哪些挑戰？
lv3: 有科學家指出，全球氣候變化令極端天氣愈來愈頻繁。政府和個人各自應承擔什麼責任，以減少氣候災難帶來的傷亡？
當自然災害發生在偏遠山區，資訊傳遞和救援往往較為困難。你認為科技（例如無人機或衛星）可以怎樣改善災難救援的效率？
